Definition: a primary word (or perhaps of Hebrew origin (H3196)); "wine" (literally or figuratively):--wine.
BiblicalUsage: Oinos is wine. Jesus says in Matthew 9:17 and Mark 2:22 that no man puts new wine into old bottles, or the bottles break and the wine runs out, new wine needs new bottles, and both are preserved.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe new wine is the picture of the new covenant, and the old skins cannot hold what Christ has poured.
RelatedEvents: The Parable of the New Wine and New Cloth
